games.name: Steal an Anime Egg!
games.desc:
⚔️ Steal An Anime Egg!

🥚 Grab an Anime Egg from a boss’s territory.
🏃 Escape the chase and bring your egg back to your plot.
🐣 Wait for it to hatch and discover your anime fighter.
💵 Place your fighters on your plot to earn cash.

🔧 Upgrade your treadmill and expand your plot.
📖 Explore different worlds and complete your anime collection!

🎮 Play on Desktop, Console, Mobile, and Tablet.

games.name: The Ayuwoki Field
games.desc:
You are trapped at the Ayuwoki's field. There's no way to escape, just stay away from him and you'll be fine. How many nights will you survive?

This game is a mix between "El Bosque del Ayuwoki" by NahuelP25 and "THE RAKE: Classic Edition" by RVVZ.

Note for the english speakers that play this Roblox experience:
This game is originally in spanish, so when I add new text I have to translate it into english, and let's just say that sometimes I forget to translate it and.. yeaahh.. sorry if you find any text in spanish.

Music used:
Menu: Alice Mako - Dragon Riders
Intermission: Alice Mako - Stress Relief; Alice Mako - Flying Fortress II; Alice Mako - Some Patterns 14
Night: Kevin MacLeod - Gathering Darkness
Chase: Amnesia - Suitor Attacks

The game was remade on October 1, 2023.

games.name: Absolvement [ALPHA]
games.desc:
An end of a lifetime, or the beginning of an era? Nobody knows what lies at the end. In fact, most believe there is no end. You struggle to differentiate between your true memories and false ones planted from your fleeting consciousness as you shatter your body but not your soul.

<> Absolvement is currently in the ALPHA development stage. <>
Fundamentals of the game may change as we release updates!

- Play solo or in parties up to 5 players
- Branded by sins, affixes, and burdens - freely choose your rate of progression and your own personal difficulty
- Classless character design and progression
- Over 130 abilities to use and build synergies with
- Earn Soul Fragments when your character wipes to unlock 200+ buffs in the Soul Tree for your next character

Absolvement is a roguelite dungeon crawler developed by Amorian Skies.
Nominated in the 2025 Creator Awards for Best Narrative.
All in-game music is our own composed OST! 
Playable on PC and Console with controller support.
